question: Mopin is the cultural festival of which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mopin** is primarily celebrated by the** Galo tribe** of **Arunachal Pradesh**, although other tribes in the region also participate in the festival.
 
• The festival is usually held in the **month of April **and is dedicated to the** goddess Mopin-Ane**, who is believed to **bless the harvest** and bring **prosperity** to the community.
 
• The festival is marked by various rituals and customs such as the **Mopin Oyi (offering) ceremony, the Popir dance,** and the traditional **Mopin feast.**
 
• The festival is an important occasion for the Galo community to come together, showcase their **cultural heritage, and strengthen social ties.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nagaland** is a state in **northeastern India** that is known for its rich cultural heritage and vibrant festivals.

 
 
• Some of the popular festivals celebrated in Nagaland include the** Hornbill Festival, the Sekrenyi Festival, and the Aoling Festival.**
 
 
 
• **Maharashtra **is a state in **western India** that is known for its **diverse culture, history, and cuisine**.
 
• Some of the popular festivals celebrated in Maharashtra include **Ganesh Chaturthi, Diwali, and Holi.**
 
• **Mizoram** is a state in northeastern India that is known for its picturesque landscapes, vibrant culture, and unique traditions.
 
 
• Some of the popular festivals celebrated in Mizoram include **Chapchar Kut, Mim Kut, and Pawl Kut.**
